Commentary.Commentary: Right then! That is all we have from this one-sided match. Australia Women and India Women are the two teams from Group A that have progressed to the next round. We now move our attention to Group B where South Africa Women will take on Sri Lanka Women in the first game on Thursday, 4th of August. The action for that game is set to begin at 3.30 pm IST (10 am GMT). In the second game of the day, we have New Zealand Women up against England Women. The winner of that game will meet India Women in the semi-final while the team on the losing side will be up against Australia Women in the other semi-final game. The important clash between New Zealand Women and England Women is scheduled to begin at 10.30 pm IST (5.00 pm GMT). But do join us early for the build-up. Till then, cheers and goodbye.

Earlier, Barbados Women won the crucial toss and put India Women to bat first. They started off well with the ball by getting rid of Smriti Mandhana but they let them get away with crucial partnerships which took the game away from them. Shafali Verma's 43 and Jemimah Rodrigues' half-ton were the two stand-out performances from the Indian side. Not to forget the important cameo from Deepti Sharma. Her knock helped India Women get over the 160-mark.

India Women got off to a perfect start when Renuka Singh got rid of the dangerous Deandra Dottin in the very first over. She never looked back after that and went on to demolish the top order of Barbados Women. She ended her spell with outstanding figures of 4 for 10 in her 4 overs. Harmanpreet Kaur used 8 bowlers and 5 of them ended up with wickets. They never gave any chance to Barbados Women batters to settle in and build partnerships. They will be really happy with their performance and to do this in a do-or-die game, speaks a lot about their squad.

It's been another abysmal batting performance from Barbados Women. They did have a big target to chase in front of them, but they came out to bat with no intent. Deandra Dottin was sent back to the hut in the first over itself. Hayley Matthews did play a few fine strokes but she followed her partner back as well. Wickets continued to tumble and Barbados Women found themselves reeling at 20 for 4 at the end of the Powerplay! Alisa Scantlebury and Trishan Holder did hang in there, but they too perished soon. Only two of their players scored over 10 runs. Well, that tells you the kind of batting show they put up. A tough day in the office for Barbados Women!

A loud cheer in Edgbaston as India Women clinch this game in style and secure a spot in the semi-final! It's been another dominating performance from the Women in Blue and they continue to march on, while the expedition for Barbados Women ends here. It's been a tough competition for them!
Back of a length, outside off. Shamilia Connell punches it off the back foot towards cover for a single. India Women win by 100 runs and they are through to the semi-finals!
Slower through the air, full and outside off. Shamilia Connell defends this one watchfully.
Tosses it up, full and outside off. Shamilia Connell presses forward and blocks it out.
Outside off, pitches it up again. Shamilia Connell blocks it out off the front foot.
Fuller now, outside off. Shamilia Connell lunges forward and defends it out.
Shorter one, around off. Shamilia Connell pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter and outside off, spinning in. Selman punches it to covers.
Floated, around off. Selman comes down the track and tries to heave but misses and gets hit on the pads.
A full toss, around leg, whipped to deep square leg for a single.
This one stays very low, length and outside off. Connell fails to flick it away and gets beaten.
A flighted full ball, outside off. Connell drives but fails to connect and the keeper whips the bails off. The batter never left her crease.
Tossed up on middle, eased down to long on for a single.
Quicker, outside off, fuller one. Shamilia Connell pushes it towards point.

OUT! TAKEN! The skipper, Harmanpreet Kaur grabs a wicket as well! India Women are two wickets away now! This is a shorter ball, outside off, extra bounce there as well. Shaunte Carrington rocks back and cuts this one. But the ball goes off the leading edge towards the backward point. Radha Yadav there takes an easy catch!
Commentary.Howout: c Radha Yadav b Harmanpreet Kaur

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller one, slower through the air, loopy ball, outside off. Shaunte Carrington leaves it alone.
Flatter now, around middle, full again. Shakera Selman flicks it towards mid-wicket. Another run!
Fuller ball, around middle. Shaunte Carrington flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery, around middle and leg. Shaunte Carrington flicks it towards square leg.
Fuller and on off. Shaunte Carrington smashes it hard straight down to long off for a single. Verman got a hand to it and is feeling the pain now.
This is full and on middle. Shaunte Carrington defends right under her eyes. The ball almost rolled back onto the stumps.

Fuller and on off. Shaunte Carrington pushes it back to Verma who lets it through her hands to mid off. The fielder converges and throws it to the keeper's end as there is a bit of mix up between the batters but the replay shows Carrington is well in.
Run out chance! There is a throw at the keeper's end. The replay shows that Shaunte Carrington brings her bat back in time. Not out it is!
On middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and on middle. Selman blocks it out.
Tossed up on middle, gets it to drift in. Shaunte Carrington keeps it out.
FOUR! Kaur serves it slightly short and outside off. Selman waits and dabs it through third man for a boundary.
Around off, fuller and it is pushed to covers.
Flatter and outside off. Selman looks to push but gets an outside edge well ahead of first slip.
Pushed through quicker and on middle, played around the corner on the leg side.
Nicely flighted on middle. Selman pushes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on off. Blocked out.
She bowls the arm ball here, on off, Shai Carrington offers no shot at it.
A bit short and outside off, Shakera Selman makes room and guides it past the first slip and towards third man for one. That brings up the 50 for Barbados Women.
Tossed up full and on leg, Shakera Selman works it to mid on.
Nice bowling. This is pushed through quicker and on off, skids through, Shakera Selman tries to play at but misses. Taniya Bhatia grabs it well behind the stumps.
FOUR! A gift and Shakera Selman accepts it. This is a dipping low full toss down the leg, Shakera Selman tucks it towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
Shakera Selman comes in to bat.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Another one bites the dust! Radha Yadav picks up her first wicket of the game and Barbados Women have lost their seventh. She serves this a bit shorter, flatter, and outside off. Alisa Scantlebury tries to slash this one but she gets a thick outside edge towards first slip. Deepti Sharma takes a good catch there.
Commentary.Howout: c Deepti Sharma b Radha Yadav

Commentary.Commentary: On a length, outside off. Shaunte Carrington dabs it towards point.
Fuller one, around middle. Shaunte Carrington pushes it towards mid-on.
Shaunte Carrington comes to the crease.

OUT! TAKEN! Harmanpreet Kaur takes a blinder to send Trishan Holder back to the hut. This is full again and around off, Trishan Holder goes for the drive but plays it uppishly towards mid off, Harmanpreet Kaur there judges it well and dives forward to take a terrific catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Harmanpreet Kaur b Meghna Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Goes full again and on middle, Trishan Holder pushes this to mid on.
BEATEN! This is on a length and on off, shaping away, Trishan Holder tries to poke at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Full delivery and on off, Alisa Scantlebury works it of her outer half to through covers. They cross.
A low full toss on middle, Alisa Scantlebury nudges it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Floated full and around off, Trishan Holder chips it towards mid off for a single.
Serves this full and outside off, Trishan Holder knocks it to short covers.

This is slower through the air and on middle, holds its line, Trishan Holder goes for the drive but misses and gets hit on her pads. There is a stiffled appeal for LBW but the finger stays down. Harmanpreet Kaur opts against the review.
Tossed up full and on middle and leg, Alisa Scantlebury flicks it through square leg for a run.
Starts with a flighted delivery on off, Alisa Scantlebury leans on and blocks it out.
Radha Yadav comes into the attack.
Full and on middle and off, Trishan Holder mistimes her drive towards mid on.
Pulls her length back a bit, Trishan Holder opens the face of her bat and guides it to point.
Fuller one and on off, Trishan Holder drives this to short covers.
Goes full and on middle, Alisa Scantlebury whips it towards deep square leg for one.
BEATEN! This is on a length and around off, Alisa Scantlebury looks to block it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Length delivery on middle and leg, Trishan Holder tucks it through square leg for a single.
Full and on off, Alisa Scantlebury knocks it to mid on.
On middle, knocked back to the bowler.

FOUR! Nice placement! This is flighted full and on middle, Alisa Scantlebury goes down and drives to the rigth of the bowler and past the diving mid on fielder for a boundary. Barbados Women needs a lot more of them.
Almost on a yorker length snd on off, Trishan Holder digs it through cover-point for one.
A bit short and around off, Trishan Holder looks to cut it but misses it completely.
Nicely tossed up around off, Trishan Holder stays back and pushes it towards short covers.
Fuller and outside off, hint of inward movement. Alisa Scantlebury looks to drive but gets beaten on the inside edge. At the halfway mark, Barbados Women are 34/5. They need 129 more runs to win.
A length ball, outside off. Alisa Scantlebury stays back and punches it straight to covers.
Length and outside off, punched to covers.
Wide! A slower bumper on middle. Alisa Scantlebury misses her pull. A wide is given for height.
Leg bye! On middle, this is worked to square leg for a single. It is given as a leg bye as Holder failed to put her bat on it.
On a length and outside off, guided to point.
Fuller ball, around middle and leg. Holder looks to flick but seems to get an inside edge onto the pads. Pooja Vastrakar puts up an appeal but nothing doing.
Slower again, full and outside off. Left alone.
BEATEN! Rana mixing really well here! bowls it slow now, fuller and outside off. Alisa Scantlebury almost edged it as she tries to drive this through covers but misses it.
Alisa Scantlebury makes her way out in the middle.

OUT! TIMBER! Rana gets one and Barbados Women are five down now! Brilliant from Rana! She gave a freebie in the previous ball but not this time. She serves this a little quicker and a bit flatter, angling around off. Knight gets on her knee and tries to slog-sweep but misses and the ball rattles the stumps.
Kyshona will feel she missed out here! A low full toss on middle. Knight pushes it straight to mid on.
This one holds a bit on the surface, tossed up, outside off. Holder edges it through backward point for one.
Slower ball, outside off. Holder looks to drive but misses.
Sneh Rana is brought into the attack.

FOUR! Much-needed boundary for Barbados and they need more of it! On a length and on middle. Kyshona pulls it hard and to deep square leg, beating the diving fielder there to collect four runs. 132 needed in 72 balls.
This one is on middle. Holder ramps it over through third man for a single.
Fuller ball, outside off, it is driven through covers for a single.
Slight halt! The umpires seem to be having some issues with Harmanpreet Kaur's jumper. She has been asked to play in her jersey! The reason for this is still unknown! Anyway, we are good to resume.
Goes fuller now, outside off. Kyshona tries to drive but gets an inside edge and it rolls back on the deck.
Length ball, outside off, good bounce there. Kyshona swings and misses.
On a length and outside off. Kyshona taps it to point.
Pooja Vastrakar is introduced into the attack!
A fabulous spell from Renuka Singh comes to an end! She ends with four wickets while giving away just 10 runs. A potential match-winning spell! This is full and on middle, eased to mid on.
Too full and on middle, pushed to the left of mid on for a single.
On a length and on off. Kyshona pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Fuller ball, outside off, nipping away. Holder looks to drive but outside edges it to backward point where the fielder dives to her and makes a solid stop. One.
On middle, flicked to mid-wicket for a quick single.
Renuka Singh starts her last over with a length ball, around leg. Knight tries to flick it away but mistimes again.
Three dots to end the over! Fuller, flighted and on middle. Holder mistimes her push back to the bowler. India all over Barbados in the powerplay as they are reeling at 20/4.
This is on a length and outside off. Holder takes a big stride forward to push at it but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Tad short and outside off. Holder plays with soft hands to covers.
Flatter ball, outside off. Kyshona chops it past point and takes a single.
Flatter and outside off. Kyshona chops it to point.
Fuller and on off. Knight flicks it to mid-wicket.
Trishan Holder walks out.

OUT! SOUND OF TIMBER! Renuka Singh can do a thing wrong in the tournament! Another four-fer for her! Barbados Women are in deep, deep trouble! A length ball, shaping in only a tad, around off. Aaliyah Alleyne shoulders her arms at this one but the ball nips back in a tad and shatters the off pole. She departs without troubling the scorers. India Women are on top of proceedings!
Pitches it up, around middle. Aaliyah Alleyne plays tit back to the bowler.
Aaliyah Alleyne is the new batter in.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Three wickets in three overs for Renuka Singh! She just cannot stop taking wickets! She gets rid of Kycia Knight now. On a length, outside off. Kycia Knight shuffles across and tries to scoop this one over short fine leg. But the ball goes off her inside edge and back onto the stumps.
A length ball now, around middle. Kycia Knight shows the full face of her bat and defends it back.
Fuller one, around middle and off. Kycia Knight pushes it back to the bowler.
Fuller ball, outside off. Kyshona Knight shows the full face of the bat and drives it past the diving fielder at cover. Three taken!
Pitches it up this time, around middle and off. Kycia Knight drags it across the line wide of long on. Two taken!
Tad fuller, outside off, extra bounce once again. Kycia Knight stays back and looks to block this one. But the ball goes off the top half of the bat and lands short of the fielder at cover.
Slower through the air, full and loopy one as well. Kyshona Knight presses forward and drives it through cover. Single taken!
Slightly shorter again, outside off, extra bounce there as well. Kyshona Knight fends it towards point and takes a single.
Back of a length again, outside off, turning away. Kyshona Knight rocks back and pushes it towards cover for a single.
Deepti Sharma begins with a shorter ball, spinning away, outside off. Kyshona Knight cuts it towards cover-point.
On a length now, outside off. Kycia Knight stays in her crease and tries to cut this away but she misses.
Pitches it up again, around middle. Kycia Knight pushes it towards mid off.
Outside off again, fuller delivery. Kycia Knight taps it towards short third man.
Fuller one again, outside off, shaping away. Kyshona Knight leaves it alone.
Kyshona Knight comes in now.

OUT! TAKEN! Wickets in quick succession for India Women and it's Renuka Singh once again! Her purple patch with the ball carries on! Fuller ball, around middle. Hayley Matthews steps down the pitch and tries to clear the fielder at mid on. But that has not been hit from the middle of the bat and therefore it lobs up towards the fielder there. Shafali Verma pouches it safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Shafali Verma b Renuka Singh

Commentary.Commentary: Pitches it up, outside off. Hayley Matthews dabs it towards point.
Fuller one again, outside off. Kycia Knight swings her bat wildly at it but she misses it.
Wide of off, fullish ball. Hayley Matthews drives it square of the wicket on the off side. Only a single.
Much fuller now, outside off. Hayley Matthews drives it to the fielder at mid off.
BEATEN! Much better from Meghna Singh! On a length, shaping away a tad, in the channel outside off. Hayley Matthews tries to block this one but she gets beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Hayley Matthews! Width on offer now, on a length. Hayley Matthews stays in her crease and slashes it past point for a boundary.
FOUR! Hayley Matthews greets Meghna Singh with a boundary! A full ball, outside off. Hayley Matthews drives it uppishly over cover for a boundary. She is off the mark in fine fashion!
Meghna Singh to bowl from the other end.
Fuller one, around middle and off. Kycia Knight pushes it towards mid-wicket. A successful first over for India Women!
Good-length delivery, outside off. Kycia Knight stays on the back foot and pushes it towards point.
Wide! Swinging away, fuller ball. Kycia Knight leaves it alone. Wide called!
A length ball, tighter line now, around off. Kycia Knight taps it towards point.
Kycia Knight walks out to the middle.n

OUT! CLEANED UP! A wicket in the first over for Renuka Singh and India Women! She continues her good form and gets rid of the dangerous, Deandra Dottin! A peach of a delivery by her! On a length, nipping back in, around middle and leg. Deandra Dottin dances down the track and swings her bat at it but she misses. The ball goes on to shatter the stumps! A duck for Deandra Dottin in what is supposed to be her final international game!
On a length, outside off, swinging in. Deandra Dottin blocks it out watchfully.
Renuka Singh begins with a fuller ball, tailing back in, around middle. Deandra Dottin blocks it out.
